While memory costs are expected to comfortably lead the bill of materials for the iPhone 18 Pro, the same may not hold true for the iPhone Duo. Here are the details.

Apple signs three-year exclusive deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital claimed in a Weibo post today that Apple and Samsung Display have signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement for foldable panels.

According to the tipster, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its subsequent models," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also noted that the panel is "one of the most expensive core components" of the device without question.

While there are no credible reports yet on the iPhone Duo's expected bill of materials cost, by breaking down the costs of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components, Apple has shared interesting information about the materials used in the device, including how much recycled content is in it.
